item.title: Build One Task Before You Build a Benchmark
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. A benchmark score is an average over a few dozen tasks, and that is the most it can be. What is scarce is whether the gap inside one of those tasks is still there. 1. The gap lives in your own session# James Zhu published 大bench时代生存指南 on X on 27 November, and this is the route it lays out.
